subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Are the revised pinned commits for the credential-bearing GitHub Actions acceptable for OpenClaw's release, token-issuance, and Codex-agent workflows?
rationale: The mechanical dependency update changes executable third-party code at secret and token boundaries; source-level review cannot substitute for an owner's trust decision on those upstream revisions.

options.title: Approve reviewed pins
options.body: Inspect the upstream commit diffs and provenance for the credential-bearing actions, record explicit acceptance, then allow the exact-head checks to complete.

options.title: Split or pause sensitive updates
options.body: Keep non-sensitive action updates separate and pause the app-token, registry, attestation, and Codex-action revisions until their trust review is complete.

recommendation.title: Approve reviewed pins
recommendation.body: Inspect the upstream commit diffs and provenance for the credential-bearing actions, record explicit acceptance, then allow the exact-head checks to complete.

likelyOwner.reason: A concrete owner cannot be established from the available read-only evidence without attributing workflow responsibility speculatively.
